name: Anomaly clue methods
description: Optional analysis methods from a pinned Anomaly detector catalogue. Approved methods run on tables a research lane collected, through Anomaly's one-shot runner, and their signals become Research clues tagged method:<id>@<version>.
egress_note: None. Methods run locally on a read-only copy of a lane table, in a child process with no keys in its environment; Anomaly loads the table into an in-memory DuckDB and disables external access before any method SQL runs.
risk_note: A method signal is a clue, never a finding or evidence. The catalogue is read only when its hash equals the pin above; any other catalogue hides the feature.
